options_considered.reason: credential/provider availability would destabilize score comparability
duplicates evidence/story/PDF truth and creates reconciliation drift
smallest reversible slice that increases measurement power while preserving core score

strongest_counterargument: If enrichment metrics never affect the score, the headline score may underrepresent newly measured search/user/performance evidence. This is accepted for this release because scoring semantics require a separate versioned calibration exercise; immediately weighting provider metrics would be less truthful than keeping them decision-supporting and visible without score impact.
failure_mode_chain: new API data -> wrong semantic mapping -> polished customer visual -> false certainty -> bad action. Controls: source-specific metric IDs, provenance schema, fail-closed availability states, claim boundaries, customer-language validator and fixture/live separation.

bias_review.precision_bias: controlled: average position/current rank and lab/field data remain separate
